remarks: Move into a newly renovated second floor unit with 2-bedrooms and 1-bath apartment ideally located just minutes from the East Norwalk Train Station, beaches, and local dining. This home features a brand-new kitchen with modern cabinetry, sleek countertops, and new appliances, along with a fully updated bathroom with a tub. Enjoy the added benefit of one-car garage parking plus additional street parking. Shared laundry is conveniently located in the basement with additional storage in the attic and basement.
